title: Preparation of amorphous calcium phosphate nanoparticles using small organic molecules for biomimetic mineralization of dentin
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20514-20525
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10131J, Paper
Open Access

Zhenni Liu, Dan Li, Xiujun Shi, Dongqin Xiao, Feng Shi, Xuwei Luo, Gang Feng, Yonglin Xie, Chengdong Zhang
IP6 and H6L effectively stabilize amorphous calcium phosphate (ACP) by inhibiting phase transformation. These ACP-based composites enable superior tubule occlusion and biomimetic mineralization for dentin repair.
